glossEn: the linear extent in space from one end to the other; the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place
note: the linear extent in space from one end to the other。**空间维度的长度**。线索：the length of the room / a 2-metre length。

glossEn: the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end
note: the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end in time。**时间维度的长度**。线索：the length of the meeting / the length of time。与 s1 分界：量的是空间还是时间。

glossEn: a section of something that is long and narrow
note: a section of something that is long and narrow。指**物体本身**。线索：a length of rope / lengths of silk。
